# hub API reference

<!-- Generated by `hub api docs`. Run `make gen` to refresh; do not edit. -->

Every operation below is reachable three ways:

- the generated command, e.g. `hub user list-user --limit 10`
- the REST endpoint, e.g. `hub api call GET /api/v1/users --query limit=10`
- the gRPC method, for a generated client

`rbac` is the permission the caller needs: the verb (`action`) on the
resource identifier. A role granting `*` on `api.*` covers everything.

## ai.chat.v1.ChatService

Approve or decline a change the assistant proposed, and stream the rest of the answer.

- command: `hub chat confirm-tool-call`
- endpoint: `POST /api/v1/chat/proposals/{id}/confirm`
- rbac: `ConfirmToolCall` on `api.ai.chat.v1.ChatService`

| flag | field | in | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--id` | `id` | path | string | uuid |
| `--approved` | `approved` | body | bool |  |

- command: `hub chat create-session`
- endpoint: `POST /api/v1/chat/sessions`
- rbac: `CreateSession` on `api.ai.chat.v1.ChatService`

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--title` | `title` | body | string | length <= 255 |
